evidence.summary: Painter is unstable on tier0/semantics/quantisation-thirds: its after-reopen recording r2 differs from its same-session recording r1 on 16 of the 36 maps (parity/reports/phase0/tier0-stability.md §4). Under decision 032 r1 is the exact target and every comparison against r1 must be exact; this entry covers only the comparisons against r2, per map in native units (16-bit codes of the 16-bit PNG exports, float values of the OpenEXR exports). Its bounds are the evaluator's published r2 residuals (parity/semantics/quantisation-profile.json, entry quantisation-isolated-root): max |delta| 512 codes (sRGB8, one 8-bit code), per-map mean at most 257 (L8, one 8-bit code on every texel of a map). Not covered: the RGB32F and L32F residuals against r1 (6 of 16 values off by 2^-25 or 2^-24), which stay divergences (task phase1.10_compositor-float32-residual).

evidence.summary: Painter is unstable on tier0/semantics/blend-inputs set s2 (fields A at opacity 0.5 over the base): r2 differs from r1 on the two sRGB8 maps (22 912 of 196 608 values each) and the RGB8 map (11 520 values) (parity/reports/phase0/tier0-stability.md §4); every other map of the golden is stable. Under decision 032 r1 is the exact target and every comparison against r1 must be exact; this entry covers only the comparisons against r2, per map in native units (16-bit codes). Its bounds are the evaluator's published r2 residuals on s2 (parity/semantics/quantisation-profile.json, entry quantisation-isolated-root): max |delta| 768, mean 58.7917, 11.6537 % differing values (the sRGB8 maps); RGB16, RGB16F, L16 and RGB32F equal r2.

evidence.summary: Painter is unstable on tier0/semantics-ui/height-normal-sharp-plane-strength and tier0/semantics-ui/height-normal-sobel-plane-strength (the domain tier0/height-normal/method): after save and reopen, r2 of sets s1 (opacity 0.75) and s4 (opacity 0.1) differs from r1 on the Height export and both virtual maps (parity/reports/phase0/tier0-semantics-ui.md §3); every other map of the domain is stable. Under decision 032 r1 is the exact target and every comparison against r1 must be exact (the evaluator equals r1 on every map, parity/semantics/height-to-normal.json); this entry covers only the comparisons against r2, per map in native units (16-bit codes of the PNG exports, float values of the OpenEXR Height). Its bounds are the evaluator's published r2 residuals (entry height-normal-save-reopen-divergence): max |delta| 31 codes (Sharp s1 Normal_OpenGL), per-map mean at most 2.4583, and every value of the s4 Height differing (by at most 2^-14).
